title.value: LSTM-RASA Based Agri Farm Assistant for Farmers
title.justification: This is explicitly mentioned in the title section of the paper, indicating the focus of the research.
title.quote: LSTM-RASA Based Agri Farm Assistant for Farmers

extractions.description: The paper presents the development of a chatbot named 'Farmer’s Assistant' using the RASA framework to provide expert agricultural advice to farmers. It aims to overcome the limitations of traditional call centers by offering real-time responses and support on agriculture-related queries using a deep learning approach. The chatbot is designed to guide farmers on plant protection and nutrient management by understanding user intents and providing corresponding expert advice.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on providing technological solutions to enhance agricultural productivity and efficiency, which is a key aspect of sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This project aims to implement a closed domain ChatBot for the field of Agriculture – “Farmer’s Assistant”. Farmers can have conversation with the Chatbot and get the expert advice in their field.
